# Polygon Swap — Polygon PoS Swap Reference

> Exchange POL, USDC and tokens on Polygon PoS — the low-fee EVM network — through a non-custodial decentralized exchange. Independent, not affiliated with Polygon Labs.

## Key Facts
- Asset: POL — native gas and staking token of Polygon PoS (replaced MATIC in the migration)
- Network: Polygon PoS (EVM-compatible, low fees)
- Gas: paid in POL
- Custody: non-custodial — swaps settle through public smart contracts; wallet signs
- Approvals: buying a token with native POL needs no approval; selling an ERC-20 needs a one-time approval
- Costs: DEX pool fee + network gas (POL) + price impact; gas usually very low
- Common route: POL -> USDC / stablecoins / tokens
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Polygon Labs
